references: Daniels J. — Daniels' Running Formula, 4th ed., Human Kinetics, 2022 (ISBN 978-1718200203).
Friel J. — The Triathlete's Training Bible, 5th ed., VeloPress, 2016 (ISBN 978-1934030837).

intensity_zones._comment_direction: threshold_pace_factor is a multiplier on threshold_pace_sec_km. Factor > 1.0 = running slower than threshold (low-intensity zones). Factor < 1.0 = running faster than threshold (high-intensity zones). Zones are listed easy->hard (Z1 first); the factor range [lo, hi] gives the fast end (lo) and slow end (hi) of each zone in sec/km terms.

recovery_jog.purpose: Active recovery — required fallback for Run-mode modulation (high_fatigue / joint_pain signals)
recovery_jog.intensity: Strict Z1, fully conversational, flat terrain

easy_run.purpose: Aerobic base volume, daily low-stress accumulation
easy_run.intensity: Z1-Z2, conversation easy, no pace pressure

long_run.purpose: Weekly aerobic cornerstone, fat-oxidation and endurance
long_run.intensity: Z1-Z2 throughout; last 20% may drift to low Z3 if feeling strong

tempo_run.purpose: Raise lactate threshold and build ability to sustain Z3 (serves as the base-phase sweet-spot equivalent)
tempo_run.intensity: Z3 as 25-40min continuous or 2x15min with 5min Z1 jog recovery

interval_run.intensity: Z4-Z5 as 6-8x1000m or 5x1500m, 90s-2min Z1 jog recovery

repetition_run.intensity: Z5 as 8-12x200m or 6-8x400m, full recovery between reps
